Choose a custom theme for system UI

Select from various custom themes to personalize your system appearance. Themes work in both light and dark mode. Each theme offers a unique color palette and visual style that applies directly to Settings pages.
Uses the standard system theme with Material You dynamic colors based on your wallpaper. This is the default Android theme that adapts to your device wallpaper.

Pure black backgrounds with depth effects using your wallpaper. Provides deep black surfaces for maximum contrast and battery savings on OLED displays. Works in both light and dark mode with adaptive tinting.

Transparent Settings pages with 70% blur effect behind content. Creates a modern, glass-like appearance that shows your wallpaper through the Settings interface. Works in both light and dark mode with adaptive transparency.
Light gray and white tones (#1E1E1E) creating a soft, snow-like appearance. Offers a subtle, elegant look with reduced eye strain. Perfect for users who prefer lighter backgrounds.

Warm brown and coffee tones with gradient. Provides a cozy, inviting aesthetic reminiscent of espresso coffee. Features rich brown gradients (#3E2723, #5D4037, #6D4C41) that create a comfortable atmosphere in Settings. Works in both light and dark mode.
Beautiful blue gradient background that transitions from dark to light blue. Creates a modern, vibrant appearance with smooth color transitions. Works in both light and dark mode.

Animated background using Lottie animations or video files. Creates a dynamic, living background that plays continuously. Currently uses Lottie animations from the raw folder, with MP4 video support coming soon.

Dynamic pastel colors that change per page. Each Settings page gets a unique pastel color (amber, blue, green, orange, or purple) with a blur mask effect. Colors are carefully chosen for high contrast and accessibility, ensuring text and cards remain readable in both light and dark mode. Inspired by Android 16 expressive material themes.

Uses your system wallpaper with a fast-moving animated blur effect. The blur radius animates continuously, creating a dynamic, living background that\'s fast enough to see the animation. Works with any wallpaper and provides a unique animated experience.

Choose a custom image from your files as the background with a blur effect. Select any image from your device storage to use as the Settings background. The image will be displayed with a blur effect for better readability.

Control data collection, tracking, and system services. Enable these features to enhance your privacy and security.

Prevent system analytics and telemetry collection. When enabled, blocks all analytics services from collecting usage data, crash reports, and performance metrics. This helps protect your privacy by preventing data collection about how you use your device.

Prevent diagnostic and usage data collection. When enabled, stops the system from sending diagnostic information, error reports, and usage statistics to Google and other services. This includes crash reports and device health data.

Disable personalized recommendations and suggestions. When enabled, prevents the system from using your data to provide personalized content, app suggestions, and adaptive features. All recommendations will be generic and not based on your usage patterns.

Disable AI/ML features that may collect data. When enabled, blocks Android Intelligence services including smart suggestions, adaptive features, and machine learning-based optimizations. This prevents AI services from accessing your data for learning and personalization.

Prevent ad-related services and tracking. When enabled, blocks advertising ID services, ad personalization, and ad-related data collection. This prevents apps and services from tracking you for advertising purposes and using your advertising ID.

Prevent automatic cloud backup of device data. When enabled, stops automatic backup of your app data, settings, and device configuration to cloud services. Your data will remain only on your device. Note: Manual backups may still be possible.

Prevent system-level location services and tracking. When enabled, disables system-wide location services, preventing apps and services from accessing your location data. This includes GPS, network-based location, and location history. Apps requesting location will be denied access.

Prevent background network and Wi-Fi scanning. When enabled, stops the system from performing background Wi-Fi and Bluetooth scans to improve location accuracy and network discovery. This reduces battery usage and prevents passive location tracking through network scanning.

Prevent automatic WebView updates. When enabled, stops automatic updates to the Android System WebView component. This prevents the system from downloading and installing WebView updates, which may be used for security patches. Use with caution as this may leave your device vulnerable to web-based security issues.

Prevent automatic system and security updates. When enabled, blocks automatic download and installation of system updates, security patches, and OTA updates. This gives you full control over when to update, but may leave your device vulnerable to security issues. Manual updates may still be possible.

Prevent installation of apps from unknown sources. When enabled, blocks installation of apps from sources other than the Play Store or approved app stores. This prevents sideloading of APK files and installation from unknown sources, improving security but limiting app installation flexibility.
